requirement: Nominal capacity shall conform to the applicable requirements of IS 2347.
acceptance_criteria: Capacity conforms to the specified requirement.
frequency: Each control unit

requirement: Body, lid and other applicable components shall be manufactured from specified compliant materials.
acceptance_criteria: Material conforms to IS 2347 and referenced material standards.
frequency: Each consignment

requirement: Safety relief device shall conform to the specified construction and performance requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Safety relief device conforms to IS 2347.
frequency: Each consignment

requirement: Gasket shall conform to the specified material and performance requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Gasket conforms to IS 2347 requirements.
frequency: Each consignment

requirement: Pressure regulating device shall operate correctly at the specified pressure.
acceptance_criteria: Device operates within the pressure requirements of IS 2347.
frequency: Each applicable production/consignment requirement

requirement: Pressure cooker shall withstand the specified air pressure without unacceptable leakage.
acceptance_criteria: No unacceptable leakage; conforms to IS 2347.
frequency: Each control unit

requirement: Pressure cooker shall withstand the specified proof pressure.
acceptance_criteria: No failure at the specified proof pressure.
sample_requirement: One sample from each capacity and type
frequency: Once a month

requirement: Safety pressure relief device shall operate under the specified pressure conditions.
acceptance_criteria: Device operates within specified limits.
frequency: Each consignment

requirement: Pressure cooker shall withstand the specified bursting pressure.
acceptance_criteria: Conforms to the specified bursting-pressure requirement.
sample_requirement: One sample from each capacity and type
frequency: Once a month

requirement: Lid shall not be capable of unsafe removal while the cooker is under pressure.
acceptance_criteria: Lid-removal safety requirement is satisfied.
sample_requirement: One sample from each capacity and type
frequency: Once a month

requirement: Handles shall withstand the specified mechanical loads.
acceptance_criteria: Handle remains secure and conforms to the applicable requirements.
sample_requirement: One sample from smallest and largest capacity
frequency: Once a year

requirement: Where an induction-compatible base is provided, it shall demonstrate the required induction performance.
acceptance_criteria: Induction performance conforms to IS 2347.
sample_requirement: One sample from each applicable capacity and type
frequency: Once a month

requirement: The water heater shall have the specified rated storage capacity and comply with the applicable requirements of IS 2082.
acceptance_criteria: Measured storage capacity conforms to the specified requirement.
frequency: As specified in the applicable inspection and testing scheme

requirement: The water heater shall heat water to the required temperature within the specified performance requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Heating performance conforms to the applicable IS 2082 requirements.
frequency: As specified in the applicable inspection and testing scheme

clause_reference: IS 2082 applicable standing heat loss requirements
requirement: The storage water heater shall comply with the specified limits for heat loss during storage.
acceptance_criteria: Standing heat loss does not exceed the applicable specified limit.
frequency: As specified in the applicable inspection and testing scheme

requirement: The storage tank and associated pressure-containing parts shall withstand the specified test pressure without unacceptable leakage or failure.
acceptance_criteria: No leakage, rupture or unacceptable deformation at the specified test pressure.
frequency: As specified in the applicable inspection and testing scheme

requirement: Accessible parts of the water heater shall be adequately protected against electric shock under normal conditions of use.
acceptance_criteria: Protection against electric shock conforms to the applicable requirements of IS 302 Part 1.
frequency: As specified in the applicable inspection and testing scheme

clause_reference: Applicable storage water heater safety requirements
requirement: The storage water heater shall remain safe under applicable abnormal operating conditions and its safety controls shall operate as required.
acceptance_criteria: No hazardous condition occurs and applicable safety requirements are satisfied.
frequency: As specified in the applicable inspection and testing scheme

test_method: IS 302 (Part 2/Sec 21):2024 in conjunction with IS 302 Part 1
clause_reference: Applicable leakage current and electric strength requirements
requirement: The water heater shall satisfy the applicable requirements for leakage current and dielectric strength.
acceptance_criteria: Leakage current and electric strength conform to the applicable specified limits.
frequency: As specified in the applicable inspection and testing scheme

test_method: Determination of gold content in parts per thousand by the applicable assay method referenced by IS 1417:2016.
requirement: Gold jewellery/artefacts shall meet the declared grade of fineness specified in IS 1417:2016.
acceptance_criteria: Measured gold content shall meet or exceed the minimum fineness specified for the declared grade.
sample_requirement: BIS LIMS records indicate a minimum sample quantity of 1.5 g for 9K gold jewellery and 1 g for other jewellery grades; sample should be free from stone/lacquer etc. where applicable.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS hallmarking/assaying procedure
facility_requirement: Assaying / testing facility with applicable IS 1417 scope

test_method: Verify the tested gold content against the fineness grade declared for the jewellery/artefact.
requirement: The article shall correspond to a permitted gold fineness grade under IS 1417:2016.
acceptance_criteria: The tested fineness shall satisfy the minimum gold-content requirement of the declared grade.
sample_requirement: Same sample as applicable for fineness / gold-content determination.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS hallmarking/assaying procedure
facility_requirement: Assaying / testing facility with applicable IS 1417 scope

test_method: X-Ray Fluorescence (XRF) or applicable method specified for the requirement.
requirement: Cadmium content shall not exceed the maximum permissible limit specified in IS 1417:2016.
acceptance_criteria: Cadmium concentration shall be within the maximum permissible limit specified by the standard.
sample_requirement: Representative jewellery/artefact sample as specified by the applicable testing procedure.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS hallmarking/assaying procedure
facility_requirement: Testing facility with applicable IS 1417 chemical-composition scope

test_method: X-Ray Fluorescence (XRF) or applicable method specified for the requirement.
requirement: Each applicable platinum group metal shall remain within the maximum permissible limit specified in IS 1417:2016.
acceptance_criteria: Each applicable platinum group metal shall be within the maximum permissible limit specified by the standard.
sample_requirement: Representative jewellery/artefact sample as specified by the applicable testing procedure.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS hallmarking/assaying procedure
facility_requirement: Testing facility with applicable IS 1417 chemical-composition scope

test_method: X-Ray Fluorescence (XRF) or applicable method specified for the requirement.
requirement: Presence of iridium shall comply with the applicable requirement of IS 1417:2016.
acceptance_criteria: Result shall comply with the applicable IS 1417 requirement.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS hallmarking/assaying procedure
facility_requirement: Testing facility with applicable IS 1417 scope

test_method: X-Ray Fluorescence (XRF) or applicable method specified for the requirement.
requirement: Presence of ruthenium shall comply with the applicable requirement of IS 1417:2016.
acceptance_criteria: Result shall comply with the applicable IS 1417 requirement.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS hallmarking/assaying procedure
facility_requirement: Testing facility with applicable IS 1417 scope

test_method: X-Ray Fluorescence (XRF) or applicable method specified for the requirement.
requirement: Presence of osmium shall comply with the applicable requirement of IS 1417:2016.
acceptance_criteria: Result shall comply with the applicable IS 1417 requirement.
frequency: As specified in the applicable BIS hallmarking/assaying procedure
facility_requirement: Testing facility with applicable IS 1417 scope

test_method: Repeat determination of gold content using the applicable assay method.
requirement: Retesting of hallmarked jewellery/artefacts is permitted subject to the tolerance specified by the standard.
acceptance_criteria: Negative tolerance on retesting shall not exceed 2 ppt.
sample_requirement: Sample of the hallmarked jewellery/artefact selected for retesting.
frequency: When retesting is required under the applicable procedure
